thread.title: Hong Kong Hang Seng Slips 0.17% on Global Outlook, Interest Rates

author: MT Newswires
title: Hong Kong Hang Seng Slips 0.17% on Global Outlook, Interest Rates
text:
Shutterstock photo The Hong Kong Hang Seng Index traded evenly and fell slightly on Tuesday, shrugging off positive Wall Street cues as investors mulled the pending G-20 meeting and the prospects for higher interest rates in the US. President Donald Trump is expected to meet with China President Xi Jinping on the sidelines Saturday at the economic summit. Tech issues rallied, but not enough to overcome the market mood, said analysts.
The broad gauge Hang Seng fell 44.22, or 0.17% to 26,331.96.
Leading the upside were Apple ( AAPL )-supplier AAC Technologies (2018:HK), up 3.0%, followed by Sunny Optical Technology (2382:Tokyo), up 2.5%, and then internet-media giant and index heavyweight Tencent (700:HK), up 1.9%.
On the downside were Wharf Real Estate (1997:HK) off 2.4%, and then China Mengniu Dairy (2319:HK) off 2.2%.
On the mainland, the Shanghai Composite fell 0.04% to 2,574:68.
In economic news, China's GDP is expected to expand 6.6% this year and slow to 6.3% next year, economists from Beijing's Renmin University said in a report.
The prediction is in line with the median forecast in a poll of 73 economists by Reuters last month.
